catholic-encyclopedia-1913-beelzebub: A 1913 entry on Beelzebub — the prince of the devils. John Francis Fenlon unfolds his scriptural names. The Pharisees charged Christ by his power. The Gospels name the dark lord. The flies' god of the underworld. His name meant the lord of flies.
